description: This file defines a React component for displaying stock market top movers, including a list component and a main component that renders gainers and losers sections. It imports types and utility functions, and exports a default React component.

methods.name: MoversList
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a list of top movers with their symbol, name, price, and percent change.

methods.name: TopMovers
methods.description: Main React component that displays top gainers and losers in a responsive two-column layout.
